rationale: No blocking defects: all three lenses ran, no acceptance criterion failed, and every adversarial concern that was spot-checked against the source was either already guarded (Windows case-insensitive path compare via comparable(); canonicalizePath falls back to resolve() and never throws) or fail-closed/low-likelihood. Confidence is forced low because coverage was partial: the lenses reviewed the 52 KB production diff (11 src files + README/COMMANDS) rather than the full 443 KB diff (tests and ~6k lines of planning docs were not independently line-reviewed), and the Jira ticket was not fetchable so the two in-repo plans were used as the acceptance reference. Deferred (not emitted, 12): UTF-8 BOM in a hand-edited prefs file reads as corrupt (fail-closed); unlocked read-modify-write can lose a concurrent CLI update; version>1 file is rewritten as version 1; empty-string [path] resolves to cwd; `status` ignores CODEMIE_SESSION_ID so it can report tracked where the Copilot CLI hook ignores a managed session; misspelled keys in a hand-edited file fail open to defaults; no realpath timeout on hung mounts; per-event session pinning for mixed-cwd sessions; Copilot Chat gate evaluated twice per hook (TOCTOU only at opt-out boundary); `include` prints 'Nothing to change' when it removed a redundant child; Claude plan text for undefined-cwd is stale vs the fail-closed code; AnalyticsStore interface differs cosmetically from the plan. Dismissed (about 10): Windows case-sensitivity, canonicalizePath throwing, corrupt-prefs masking corrupt scope (still fail-closed), status JSON corrupt ambiguity (preferencesCorrupt flag exists), 'no tests' (tests excluded from lens diff), logging nits, file-size DoS, and similar.
